content.title: April Fools' Day! 20 'dad' jokes, one-liners, pranks to try on April 1
content.text: April 1, 2026, 1:20 p.m. PTApril showers bring May flowers, but they also bring great pranks and jokes — especially on April Fools' Day!While you're pulling pranks on your coworkers, family and friends, or looking out for that Nevada pink moon tonight (that's really not a joke!), here are some harmless April Fools ideas to try on your friends.These bad — I mean "dad" — jokes are guaranteed to bring you a little bit of laughter ... but that was an April Fools' joke, so who knows.Here are 20 dad jokes and harmless pranks to use on April Fools' Day:(Warning: The RGJ is not responsible if there is no laughter from these jokes.)10 April Fools' Day dad jokes, punsWhy don't eggs tell April Fools' Day jokes? They'd crack each other up.Want to hear a joke about construction? I'm still working on it! (April Fools.)I tried to catch fog on April Fools' Day... But I mist.Why was the calendar so scared on April 1? It knew it was about to be fooled.Since today is April Fools' Day, believe nothing and trust no one ... Just like any other day!I'm only having one drink. (April Fools' Day).Can February March? No, but April May.Why did the coffee file a police report on April Fools’ Day? It got mugged.Why don't skeletons prank each other on April Fools' Day? They don't have the guts.What's the biggest difference between April Fools' Day and Thanksgiving? One you're thankful, and the other you're prankful.10 April Fools' Day silly, harmless pranksTell someone you put diesel in your car instead of regular gas.Bring a doughnut box to the office, but replace it with a vegetable tray.Put a small piece of tape over the bottom sensor of someone's computer mouse.Put googly eyes on everything in the house or at the office.Hide all the utensils.Temporarily switch the "m" and "n" keys on someone's keyboard.Put tissues in the toe of someone's shoes, so they think they don't fit.Tell someone to ask a mechanic to check on their blinker fluid.Tell everyone you're making brownies, but cut out and serve brown paper E's.Change the bags in the cereal boxes.Jaedyn Young covers local government for the Reno Gazette-Journal.
